class.name: SpineAnimationTrack
class.brief_description: Internal class to allow composing animations on [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] instances via Godot's animation player and animation editor.
class.description: Internal class to allow composing animations on [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] instances via Godot's animation player and animation editor.

method.name: get_animation_name
method.description: Returns the Spine animation name played by this track key.

method.name: get_loop
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the track key loops the animation.

method.name: set_animation_name
method.description: Sets the Spine animation name played by this track key.

method.name: set_loop
method.description: Sets whether the track key loops the animation.

method.name: update_animation_state
method.description: Applies this track key to the target [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] animation state. Called by the animation player during playback.
